title: Choose map factions
summary: Set the default Allies and Axis teams and review their player appearance.
outcome: Saved team defaults for the map.

sections.title: Select teams

steps.title: Open faction settings
steps.text: Choose Create → Factions…. Choose Allies and Axis defaults from their selectors.

steps.title: Inspect appearance
steps.text: Search player variants and inspect the body, head, hands, and detail preview. These choices help judge appearance before saving.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.text: Choose Apply to save team choices and any replacement appearances.

tips: The walk preview represents Allies, Assault, class 1; other variants are appearance previews.
If importing a Blender replacement, use the window’s Save Blender kit… and Import Blender model… workflow; the current importer supports color-only materials.
